source_sword_scope: Project-original dimensional reference only; sword art itself is not approved for runtime.
ownership_basis: Original project-generated glove and original project-authored sword geometry only; no third-party model, rig, or motion.
method: Rigid uniform 0.9 scale and 90 degree axial spin about the measured original glove channel, aligned to the actual sword handle centre; no glove or sword mesh vertices were edited.
finger_side_definition: Measured channel axis with source-local +X projected onto its perpendicular plane; only strictly positive signed half-space counts. Four axial windows remain geometric proxies, not semantic finger-pad segmentation.
qa_gates: Source file hashes and local mesh fingerprints preserved
Full sword and glove triangle crossing count zero with containment check
Each of four finger-side longitudinal contact zones has two or more wrap samples within 0.3–0.8 mm
Crossguard, ricasso and pommel have positive measured sample clearance
Five or more visual views including axial end and full sword proportion
Both original mesh objects included in saved Blend and exported GLB
non_claims: Local rigid grip fit is not approval of the glove's rounded fingertips, thumb web, closed wrist, material, retopology, rigging or animation.
This does not approve the project-original dimensional reference sword as final art.
No forearm attachment, character assembly or runtime publication in this run.
